HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

4. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose
